name: Premonitions
overview: Scripture reveals that certain knowledge, including future events or premonitions, belongs solely to God, as He alone holds the secret things while He has disclosed what is necessary for obedience (Deuteronomy 29:29). God communicates His plans through His chosen servants, the prophets, and promises to pour out His Spirit, enabling prophecy, dreams, and visions as signs of His sovereign revelation (Amos 3:7; Joel 2:28). Believers are called to trust in the Lord wholeheartedly rather than relying on their own understanding, recognizing God's unique and unmatchable authority over all things past and future (Proverbs 3:5; Isaiah 46:9).
